arm: l1a1y8sv2r3hm32bfp: the map probe build l1a1y8sv2r3hm32p with BF16 MTP-draft KV and the target KV pool capped at 1,375,552 tokens (BF16DRAFTCAP). One edit differs from hm32p
why: vLLM #60023 measured FP8 KV in the MTP layer's attention lowering conditional acceptance at depth 2 and beyond (0.66 to 0.72 FP8 vs 0.74 to 0.80 BF16 on Flash-Next). The 10-11 plan expected near zero on top of D3, which was trained with FP8 draft KV emulated, and never ran it once D3 shipped; the 10-11 arm l1a1y8sv3 died of an OOM because SGLang sized the pool as if the draft were FP8. The cap keeps total KV bytes about 0.2 GB under today's. This probe measures the accept change cheaply with this week's spare quota; it cannot promote anything
instrument: 300 s per game Kaggle probe, 25 games; kernel.log, serve.log Decode lines (accept at 8+ running on probe contexts)
